name: fix-v2-sanitize-content
change: Sanitize build/test hook failure content before queueing memories.
rationale: Tests whether parsing stdout/stderr directly and stripping shell-paste fragments preserves useful build/test recall while eliminating serialized tool_response and heredoc leakage.
notes: This is cumulative over fix-v1-no-session, so session-memory.sh remains non-invoked.
The sanitize delta is scoped to build/test content and metadata.error_details.
